instructions.description: To begin this exercise, lie supine (flat on your back) and extend the legs.
Extend your arms and place them by the sides of the body, then lightly press the hands into the ground.
Exhale, then lift the legs upwards until you reach a point where you feel as though your lower back is going to peel off of the ground.
Stop here and take a small inhale before controlling the legs on the way down, maintaining the ground contact with the lower back.
At the bottom of the movement, keep the feet hovering off the ground, then repeat.

performanceMetrics.notes: Count repetitions completed with controlled technique.
